label: Sales Discovery Planning
description: Prepare discovery questions, qualification criteria, and account research prompts.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to run a sales discovery call or qualify an opportunity.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for generic product requirements.

label: Sales Outreach
description: Write prospecting, follow-up, or account-specific outreach messages.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for cold email, LinkedIn outreach, or follow-up copy.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for support remediation steps.

label: Enterprise Proposal
description: Draft or review enterprise sales proposals, rollout plans, and buying-committee materials.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for proposal content, mutual action plans, security/commercial positioning, or enterprise rollout language.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal contract approval.

label: Objection Handling
description: Prepare responses to buyer concerns, risks, pricing objections, or adoption blockers.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to respond to a sales objection.

label: Account Plan
description: Plan account strategy, stakeholders, risks, and next steps.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for sales account planning.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for general market strategy only.

label: Demo Script
description: Write product demo scripts and discovery-aligned walkthroughs.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for demo talk track.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for technical test plan.

label: Sales Follow-Up
description: Draft sales follow-up notes after calls, demos, or objections.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for follow-up sales message.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for support apology only.

label: Competitor Battlecard
description: Create competitive sales positioning and objection responses.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for unbiased academic comparison only.

label: Sales Call Summary
description: Summarize sales calls into needs, risks, next steps, and owners.

classifier.useWhen: User provides sales notes or transcript.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal contract summary.

label: Mutual Action Plan
description: Create shared buyer/seller action plans, timelines, and owners.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for mutual action plan or close plan.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for project sprint plan.
